decision_unit: one unique completed M3 decision, not each polling call
input_requirements: completed H4, M15 and M3 candles
decision timestamp strictly later than the frozen start
record snapshot environment and frame-bar open/observation timestamps
retain HOLD/blocker decisions, not only actionable signals
accepted_fill_inclusion: Accepted automatic XAUUSD PAPER positions only, matched by real OANDA entry timestamp after the start. Exclude manual orders, corrected manual-paper positions, broker executions and older strategies.
outcome_rule: Use observed executable-side OANDA bid/ask at paper entry/exit; unknown fees, funding and gap costs remain unquantified. Do not mark-to-midpoint or assume an unobserved fill.
if_minimum_is_not_met: Report sample as insufficient; do not claim win-rate or profitability validation.
holdout: The existing final holdout and every historical backtest/optimization/session-study artifact are reserved and excluded from this evaluation.
retuning: No thresholds, session windows, risk parameters or rule changes may be selected from this frozen forward period.
broker_execution: None; practice PAPER observations and records only.
risk_note: Planned gross price risk only; not a guaranteed maximum realized loss or net result.
